name: celld
license_note: Upstream Apache-2.0 (denoland/celld). Binary is optional, explicit-pin only; mirror does not vendor source.
notes: Binary and .gz live under bin/ (gitignored via repo-root bin/). Commit pin.json + *.sha256 only.
celld dev needs esbuild on PATH (or CELLD_ESBUILD). Without it, Start identity still works; Worker/DO bundling does not.

Local DO persist/restart observed via examples/cloudflare-celld (counter n continued after celld dev restart). Capability manifest CF-DO-RESTART stays unavailable until a wired CI/integration job owns that claim.
